customer = a person who buys something in a shop
brand = the name of a company that makes a product
second-hand = already used by someone else; not new
online shopping = buying goods on the internet
delivery = bringing goods to your home
expensive = costing a lot of money
cheap = costing little money
value for money = good quality for the price you pay
hairdresser's = a shop where you have your hair cut
post office = a place where you send letters and parcels
bank account = an arrangement with a bank to keep your money
withdraw = to take money out of a bank account
ATM = a machine that gives you cash from your account
afford = to have enough money to buy something
price = how much you must pay for something
open late = staying open after the usual closing time
shop = a place where you buy things
store = a large shop
supermarket = a large shop that sells food and household goods
hypermarket = a very large supermarket, often with parking
